notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
1. New large garage with the capacity up to4 cars at once
2. The service station system of orders for players
3. Opportunity to buy a car
4. Repair system and working with the details were reworked due to the users' request
5. More engine details
6. Car suspension for every vehicle and the chance to fix it
7. The hoist for better car suspension fixes (and any other bottom car details too)

Coming soon:
1. New garage for car painting and the painting stages at large (old paint removal, grounding, painting itself, polishing)
2. Greater motor car park: sportscars, retro cars, jeeps, trucks
3. The sell-and-buy system for the car details
4. The opportunity to buy more garages
5. The chance to search for cars at the dump and further repairing
